title: New full-res signals alone: dense flow / hand segmentation / full-res per-pixel
why: The cached 26 features are 160x90; test whether dense flow, hand/active-work segmentation and native-resolution per-pixel statistics carry NEW signal
hypothesis: Dense flow (divergence/curl/stability) and hand-motion fraction separate NO_ACTIVE_WORK / HANDS_NOT_VISIBLE better than the 160x90 features, in-domain and OOD
data: IndEgo gold 150 + Egocentric-10K OOD-160 human labels
method: 24 new features extracted at full-res decode (flow every frame, hand ~60 frames/window, native per-pixel); AUROC of each as a bad-score, sign fit on gold then applied to OOD (factory-grouped CI)

title: Incremental value on top of the 26-feature + EG2 ensemble
why: Measure whether the new signals add accuracy to the current best frozen ensemble
hypothesis: Adding flow + hand features to the ensemble lifts in-domain LOCO and OOD AUROC
method: Logistic on [ensemble good-score] + group features; LOCO on gold, train-all-gold -> OOD; paired grouped bootstrap gain vs baseline ensemble

title: Best combined signal set vs the ensemble baseline
why: Pick the best combined new-signal configuration and report the gap to 95%
hypothesis: flow+hand+full-res together beat every subset and the baseline

summary: Hand features are the best new OOD signal (hand_n_mean OOD 0.633, hand_motion_frac 0.610 vs baseline 0.566); full-res sharpness fr_lap_var_p10 is the best single in-domain (0.788); flow is informative in-domain (0.71-0.75) but near chance OOD (0.47-0.57).
decision: Keep hand segmentation and full-res sharpness as candidate features; drop flow alone and flow_stability/div/curl

summary: ens+hand: gold 0.834->0.827, OOD 0.566->0.613 (+0.050); ens+flow OOD +0.038; ens+fullres hurts (gold -0.100, collinear with ensemble).
decision: Add hand features to the ensemble; do not add full-res sharpness (redundant)

summary: Best combined ens+flow+hand: gold 0.807, OOD 0.643 [+0.522,+0.781] (paired OOD gain +0.083), mean-domain 0.725 vs baseline 0.700. Gap to 95%: 14.3 pts in-domain, 30.7 pts OOD.
decision: Adopt flow+hand as an OOD-oriented add-on to the ensemble; still far from 95%, and gains are underpowered (n_bad=22)
